warnings: Railing TYPE 1, the upper-balcony balustrade called out from A-06. It is a PAINTED STEEL BOX section design -- 2"x4" RHS posts and top rail with 1"x2" RHS horizontals at 0.20 m, all 'หนาไม่น้อยกว่า 2 มม'.

*** THIS IS A COMPLETELY DIFFERENT MATERIAL FROM THE STAIR AND RAMP RAILS. *** A-17 and A-19 use stainless tube (ø 1 1/2" and ø 1"); this one is painted steel box. Same 0.90 m height, entirely different specification and price. Do not carry one across to the other.
Overall height 0.90 m above the balcony floor, made up of a 0.10 m concrete upstand and a 0.80 m steel frame. The balcony itself is 0.10 m below the bedroom floor (+3.30 against +3.40).

POST SPACING IS ONLY PARTLY FIXED: the 4.00 m face is dimensioned '0.15 / EQ / EQ / EQ / EQ / 0.15', leaving the divisions to be set out equally on site, while the 2.00 m return is fully dimensioned 0.05 / 0.75 / 0.75 / 0.15. A take-off has to count posts off the EQ face rather than read them.
The balcony is exactly one grid bay, 4.00 x 2.00 m, in A-B x 1-2.
Railing type 2, called out on the ground-floor plan, is a separate detail on A-21.
